parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK+SK) or Security Token Service (STS) temporary authorization.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Enterprise identity, also known as enterprise ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
